name: radial-progress
description: Radial tick-gauge progress and loading indicator with a traveling height wave.

props.name: activeColor
props.description: Active tick color. Defaults to theme success green.

props.name: animate
props.description: Play wave animations. Defaults to  `animate` (true).

props.name: bowing
props.description: How much straight lines bow/curve in rough.js.

props.name: fillStyle
props.description: Fill pattern when the shape has a fill color.

props.name: fillWeight
props.description: Weight/thickness of individual hatch lines inside patterned fills.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Custom formatter for center text when `children` is omitted.

props.name: hachureAngle
props.description: Angle in degrees of hatch lines for patterned fills.

props.name: hachureGap
props.description: Spacing between hatch lines for patterned fills.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value for progress calculation.

props.name: roughness
props.description: Sketchiness intensity passed to rough.js. Higher values look messier.

props.name: seed
props.description: Locks the hand-drawn wobble. Omit to follow SketchSeedProvider or fixed-then-randomize.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Whether to display the center value / children.

props.name: size
props.description: Overall diameter size preset or custom pixel number.

props.name: sketchColor
props.description: Stroke (outline) color override. Falls back to theme ink.

props.name: startAngle
props.description:
Start angle in degrees (0° = top / 12 o'clock, clockwise).
Default `225` starts at bottom-left so the open gap sits at the bottom.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Width of sketch strokes in pixels.

props.name: sweepAngle
props.description: Sweep angle in degrees of the open arc.

props.name: tickCount
props.description: Total number of radial tick bars along the arc.

props.name: trackColor
props.description: Inactive tick color. Defaults to muted track ink.

props.name: value
props.description:
Current progress value (determinate mode).
When undefined, operates in indeterminate loading wave mode.

props.name: waveSpeed
props.description: Wave animation speed in seconds per full cycle.
